name: cospark
description: Connect Cospark for ad research, image and video generation, voiceovers, and media inspection.

interface.shortDescription: Create end-to-end AI video ads from chat.
interface.longDescription: Research ad references and create images, video clips, UGC ads and voiceovers through Cospark. Load maintained workflow guidance with read_docs and inspect outputs before delivery.
defaultPrompt: Create a UGC ad from my reference images and script.
Generate three short hook variants from this exact starting frame and keep the character consistent.
Inspect this finished ad and identify any spoken line that differs from my script.
Find five video ad references for my category and compare their hooks from the contact sheets.
Replace only the flawed section of this UGC ad without regenerating the full video.
